attributes.name: news headline truncation
attributes.definition: Whether news headlines are displayed in full or clipped/truncated (e.g., ellipsis, line clamp).

values.definition: Headlines are shown completely without clipping.
Truncation treatment is not present or not determinable.

attributes.name: news headline typographic treatment
attributes.definition: Heading level and font style/weight used for news headlines.

values.definition: Headlines are medium-weight sans-serif in an h4 heading.
Headlines are bold sans-serif headings of any level.
Headlines are set in a serif face.
